title: Where do we start

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Are you rested?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you rested?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure. What is happening with your memories? You were remembering old books, cryo-sleep...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. What is happening with your memories? You were remembering old books, cryo-sleep...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure. What is happening with your memories? You were remembering old books, cryo-sleep...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure. What is happening with your memories? You were remembering old books, cryo-sleep...?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I remember pain. Do you... care?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember pain. Do you... care?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you even ask that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you even ask that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would you even ask that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would you even ask that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I do.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You weren't too considerate yesterday.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You weren't too considerate yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I felt like you didn't believe me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I felt like you didn't believe me.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If you would just trust me, maybe I could try to explain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you would just trust me, maybe I could try to explain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry Ava.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But you still don't believe me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you still don't believe me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I believe you. I really do. But I cannot see how it's possible!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe you. I really do. But I cannot see how it's possible!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I believe you. I really do. But I cannot see how it's possible!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I believe you. I really do. But I cannot see how it's possible!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I was tired, and you deserve better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right. I'm sorry. I was tired, and you deserve better.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right. I'm sorry. I was tired, and you deserve better.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right. I'm sorry. I was tired, and you deserve better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But the premise is ridiculous!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But the premise is ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Why can't you believe it? I can remember cryogenic freezing

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why can't you believe it? I can remember cryogenic freezing

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you were frozen?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you were frozen?!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I believe I was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe I was.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. But how did you end up as an Automata?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. But how did you end up as an Automata?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Right. But how did you end up as an Automata?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Right. But how did you end up as an Automata?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: First of all, there's the memories. Initially they were vague... fleeting. But now they have become more... solid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First of all, there's the memories. Initially they were vague... fleeting. But now they have become more... solid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe someone implanted them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe someone implanted them?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Maybe... but who? And why? For now, we have to believe they are real.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe... but who? And why? For now, we have to believe they are real.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do we know then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do we know then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's hard, but I'll try to follow you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hard, but I'll try to follow you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's hard, but I'll try to follow you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's hard, but I'll try to follow you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I remember books. I remember the cold... being frozen. Blinding pain. And an old network, like a golden road of data.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember books. I remember the cold... being frozen. Blinding pain. And an old network, like a golden road of data.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The books ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The books ...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I remember the bindings. They were printed on real paper.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember the bindings. They were printed on real paper.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That would make you really old. Or really rich.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That would make you really old. Or really rich.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That would make you really old. Or really rich.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That would make you really old. Or really rich.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: There's been no new paper books for over 138 years. So if I remember them, why the large gap in my memory?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's been no new paper books for over 138 years. So if I remember them, why the large gap in my memory?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cryogenics ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cryogenics ...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: An old practice, but one that periodically draws interest and investments, before inevitably falling out of fashion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An old practice, but one that periodically draws interest and investments, before inevitably falling out of fashion.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But why would you get yourself frozen? Do we still freeze people?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But why would you get yourself frozen? Do we still freeze people?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But why would you get yourself frozen? Do we still freeze people?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But why would you get yourself frozen? Do we still freeze people?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don't have much data, but generations of desperate humans have frozen themselves in hope of waking to a brighter future.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have much data, but generations of desperate humans have frozen themselves in hope of waking to a brighter future.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The pain...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The pain...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Unbearable. Everywhere. Every cell in my body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unbearable. Everywhere. Every cell in my body.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to you?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: A sickness, maybe. Something which affected the nerves? Although some injury cannot be ruled out. And this pain wasn't mental, it was in my body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A sickness, maybe. Something which affected the nerves? Although some injury cannot be ruled out. And this pain wasn't mental, it was in my body.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This old network you mentioned...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This old network you mentioned...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have no clue. We need to find someone who knows something about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no clue. We need to find someone who knows something about it.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What should we focus on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What should we focus on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But what could cause such pain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But what could cause such pain?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But what could cause such pain?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But what could cause such pain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But who would implant those memories?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But who would implant those memories?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But who would implant those memories?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But who would implant those memories?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You still don't believe me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still don't believe me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course I believe you. I owe it to you to find your answers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I believe you. I owe it to you to find your answers.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Of course I believe you. I owe it to you to find your answers.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Of course I believe you. I owe it to you to find your answers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just exploring all possibilities.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just exploring all possibilities.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We know someone ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We know someone ...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe we can find someone with knowledge about old illnesses?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Maybe we can find someone with knowledge about old illnesses?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's fallen out of favor for quite some time...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's fallen out of favor for quite some time...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Again, assuming that the memory was not implanted...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Again, assuming that the memory was not implanted...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Again, assuming that the memory was not implanted...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Again, assuming that the memory was not implanted...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Of course. But why would anyone do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. But why would anyone do that?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: A lot of questions and no clear answers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A lot of questions and no clear answers.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: ... Gan Coilson. The vacuum cleaner! Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... Gan Coilson. The vacuum cleaner! Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's hope his wife hasn't caught him yet!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's hope his wife hasn't caught him yet!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let's hope his wife hasn't caught him yet!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let's hope his wife hasn't caught him yet!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do we know of anyone else who had their conscience transferred to an artificial construct?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do we know of anyone else who had their conscience transferred to an artificial construct?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do we know of anyone else who had their conscience transferred to an artificial construct?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do we know of anyone else who had their conscience transferred to an artificial construct?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Not that I'm aware of. We might have better luck talking to androids about this than humans. Less taboo for them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not that I'm aware of. We might have better luck talking to androids about this than humans. Less taboo for them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a Hail Mary, but I can ask any bot that's willing to speak to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a Hail Mary, but I can ask any bot that's willing to speak to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a Hail Mary, but I can ask any bot that's willing to speak to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a Hail Mary, but I can ask any bot that's willing to speak to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wonder if we are missing something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wonder if we are missing something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I wonder if we are missing something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I wonder if we are missing something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there a historic example?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there a historic example?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We can try asking him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can try asking him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Everything was so crazy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everything was so crazy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still considering it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still considering it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Please start making sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please start making sense.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We can try to ask his wife.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can try to ask his wife.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: So what's our next step?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what's our next step?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What about Gan Coilson? The vacuum cleaner?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about Gan Coilson? The vacuum cleaner?
